scripts.dev: pnpm db:migrate:local && pnpm build && wrangler dev --config packages/api/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to packages/database/.wrangler/state --var APP_ORIGIN:http://127.0.0.1:8787
scripts.dev:api: pnpm db:migrate:local && wrangler dev --config packages/api/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to packages/database/.wrangler/state --var APP_ORIGIN:http://127.0.0.1:8787
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply hive --local -c packages/database/wrangler.d1.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply hive --remote -c packages/database/wrangler.d1.jsonc
scripts.db:backup: wrangler d1 export hive --remote --output backups/hive.sql -c packages/database/wrangler.d1.jsonc
